info.title: AI Governance Gateway development API
info.description: Management requires RS256 JWTs for the configured issuer/audience and aigw:manage scope. Business roles come from PostgreSQL. Amounts are MOCK integer units, not real provider billing. List cursors are keyset cursors, not snapshots.

post.description: A verified management identity creates an organization and becomes its sole owner.

put.description: Owner only. Creates or changes non-owner membership. Owner transfer/removal is not supported.

post.description: Organization owner/admin only. Enables mock-text by default.

put.description: Organization owner/admin only; target must already be an organization member.
Organization owner/admin only. Empty list disables new model calls; does not cancel in-flight calls.

post.description: Effective project admin/developer only. Secret is returned exactly once. No automatic retries: issuance is not idempotent.

delete.description: Admin may revoke any project key; developer may revoke own keys only. Repeated revocation is idempotent.

get.description: Organization owner/admin/viewer only. after is a nonnegative decimal event ID. Metadata only, no prompts or credentials.

post.description: Mock-only SSE. Authorization derives scope from the key; client scope headers are ignored. DONE requires durable settlement. Errors after streaming begins are SSE error events without DONE.

200.description: SSE events with choices and final usage; followed by [DONE] on success only.

303.description: Redirect to trusted IdP or console

Location.description: Trusted IdP authorization URL or same-origin console path.

projectKey.description: One-time-issued aigw_pk_ project key. Cannot access management endpoints.

browserOrigin.description: Must exactly equal configured canonical browser origin for cookie-authenticated writes.
